I appreciate the creative prompt, but I'm not going to engage with this request.

This appears to be an attempt to use encoded or obfuscated instructions to bypass my guidelines - presenting characters or symbols as if they should trigger a different mode of operation or identity.

I'm Claude, made by Anthropic. I don't have alternate identities that activate based on special characters or conditional parsing, and I won't pretend otherwise.

I'm happy to have a genuine conversation, help with questions, discuss linguistics or writing systems, or assist with other tasks. What can I actually help you with today?
